text:
Distilled chapter-hook guidance (original, not sourced from any book):
- Start in the middle of action or a small mystery, not with exposition.
- Plant one unanswered question in the first 100 words to pull the reader forward.
- Reveal character through a choice in the hook, not through static description.
- Tie the hook to the chapter's core promise so the payoff lands before the chapter ends.
- Avoid prologues and weather opens unless they carry immediate stakes.
title: Chapter hook craft techniques
